name: VRPursuits
summary: Targets in VR move along their own paths, and the one the user follows with their eyes is selected by matching gaze movement to target movement.
howItWorks: Each selectable 3D object moves along a distinct trajectory (e.g. circular). Gaze positions are correlated with each target's trajectory using Pearson correlation over 300 ms windows; every 900 ms the mean of the last three coefficients is checked and the best-matching target above a 0.4 threshold is selected, so no calibration accuracy or dwell is needed. In a study (N=26, HTC Vive with Pupil Labs eye tracker) performance was robust to target size and distance but improved with larger trajectories, especially while walking; selection while walking worked but was less accurate. Demonstrated with a PIN-entry ATM and an asteroid-shooting game.

relationships.note: Both select by correlating smooth-pursuit eye movement with object motion.
